tagline.en: NVIDIA Cosmos Predict 2.5 — a world-model foundation for text-, image-, and video-to-world generation, in 2B and 14B sizes.
tagline.zh: NVIDIA Cosmos Predict 2.5——支持文本/图像/视频到世界生成的世界模型基座,提供 2B 与 14B 两种规模。

en: Cosmos Predict 2.5 is the next step in NVIDIA's Cosmos family of world foundation models. It generates world video from text, an image, or an existing clip, targeting physical-AI and simulation workloads where you want a model that reasons about how scenes unfold.

It ships in 2B and 14B sizes under the NVIDIA Open Model License. Compared with Predict 2, it adds a Reason1 language conditioner and a flow-UniPC scheduler, decoding through a shared Wan VAE; text prompting, guidance, and image/video latent conditioning all run through the same diffusion pipeline.
In WorldFoundry it runs through the shared native diffusion pipeline — give it a prompt and, optionally, an image or video, pick the 2B or 14B checkpoint, and it generates the world video.
zh: Cosmos Predict 2.5 是 NVIDIA Cosmos 世界基础模型家族的进一步演进。它可从文本、一张图像或一段已有视频生成世界视频,面向物理 AI 与仿真负载,适合需要模型推理场景如何展开的用途。
它以 NVIDIA Open Model License 提供 2B 与 14B 两种规模。相较 Predict 2,它引入 Reason1 语言条件器与 flow-UniPC 调度器,并通过共享的 Wan VAE 解码;文本提示、引导以及图像/视频的隐空间条件都在同一扩散 pipeline 中处理。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它通过统一的原生扩散 pipeline 运行:给出提示词,并可选地附上一张图像或一段视频,选择 2B 或 14B checkpoint,它便生成世界视频。

whenToUse.en: When you want a Cosmos world model that accepts text, image, or video as input for physical-AI and simulation work, and want a choice between a lighter 2B and a higher-fidelity 14B.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个可接受文本、图像或视频输入的 Cosmos 世界模型,用于物理 AI 与仿真,并希望在更轻的 2B 与更高保真的 14B 之间选择时。

notFor.en: Checkpoints are released under the NVIDIA Open Model License and downloaded separately, so plan for access and disk space. The 14B needs substantially more hardware than the 2B.
notFor.zh: Checkpoint 以 NVIDIA Open Model License 发布并需单独下载,请预留访问权限与磁盘空间。14B 所需硬件明显高于 2B。
